---
title: "Rabinovich-Fabrikant System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& yz-y+ax^2y+x\\
\dot{y} &=& xz+x-x^3+by\\
\dot{z} &=& -z-xyz
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.6,b=0.07$ and initial condition $(2,-1,1)$.
